title: Perfect for a solo traveller
text: Very convenient. I downloaded the audioguide in the hotel and after that I used it offline. It worked great. No rush, no crowds. I make as many stops I needed and then moved on when im ready. Plus, the information was not a wikipedia style. There were some jokes, legends, city ctories. Very entertaining. Perfect for solo travellers
author: mariahsinel

title: Your local guide in Seville
text:
It’s really convenient for a short trip. I visited all the sights without worrying about getting lost. By the way, I didn't know Game of Thrones was filmed in Seville. It was cool to check out the dragon pit!
The app also includes audio guides for Seville's main attractions—the Cathedral and the Alcázar. There are so many interesting stories!
author: 18katey
